correctness.rationale: For each possible mixed palindrome, symmetry forces its center to be the midpoint of a complete maximal run. The exact remaining-run lengths on both sides yield radii min((j-1)p,(k-j)p+b) and min((j-1)p+a,(k-j)p), whose maxima evaluate to the parity-dependent R0,R1. Every allowed radius occurs and distinct rays do not collide. Every candidate absent palindrome is precisely a missing symmetric two-letter extension of an occurring palindromic interior, proving the length-polynomial identity. R0+R1=(k-1)p yields H(1)=kp+1, the total kp+4, and the maximal occurring palindrome has length (k-1)p+max(a,b), yielding maximal MAPW length kp-min(a,b)+2. The standalone verifier independently checked literal factor sets and all length coefficients for 392 triples (a,b in 1..7, k in 1..8), 14,504 coefficient checks; the proof, not those samples, establishes all parameters.

originality.rationale: Originality is assessed solely for the explicit two symmetric-wing families of palindromic factors in finite (0^a1^b)^k, the full length-by-length MAPW enumerator with parity-sensitive cutoffs, and the exact longest MAPW length. The general missing-eertree-edge characterization is Mieno et al. (2020), and the total MAPW count is an elementary rich-word consequence of Glen et al. (2008) combined with it: neither is claimed as new. Directly compared recoverable earlier findings concern ordinary minimal absent factors of >=3-letter cyclic periods, closed factors, or binary four-run minimal unique factors. The inspected source statements did not give the finite-power MAPW polynomial. Priority remains subject to an unlocated equivalent specialized treatment.

value.rationale: A complete length-resolved MAPW antidictionary for the natural run-length-encoded binary period (0^a1^b)^k is a motivated exact benchmark for eertree/MAPW construction on repetitive strings. It specifies every palindrome via two compact rays, all length multiplicities via one polynomial, and the exact furthest endpoint obstruction, capturing parity-dependent finite-word effects suppressed by known rich-word scalar counts. It makes no general performance, priority, or certification claim.
